d:
In Delhi, police personnel staged a protest outside their own police headquarters, triggered by the transfer of two of their colleagues. ACP Manasvi Vashishth, who led the demonstration, has now been suspended. The matter is linked to a dispute between the police and lawyers. How did an incident—which began with an injury to a lawyer—escalate into a protest outside the police headquarters and the subsequent suspension of an ACP?
Production: Supriya
Video Editor: Shakir Khan
